skill.description: Configure, extend, or contribute to Hermes Agent with explicit local/runtime safety boundaries.

memory.responsibility: Retain hermes configuration plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform agent runtime into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through tools and models while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose the minimum service operations required for the requested target; writes require an explicit preview gate.

stages: Connect tools skills or model settings

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
